reference.source: Parsons' Diseases of the Eye 23rd Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Fungal ulcers are dry with satellites
Ring infiltrate with pain means acanthamoeba
reference.pathophysiology: Stromal proteases from bacteria and neutrophils liquefy collagen once epithelium breaches, while fungal hyphae track lamellae resisting penetration and acanthamoeba cysts encyst against drugs; hypopyon leukocytes sediment by gravity in the anterior chamber.
additionalDifferentials: Bacterial versus fungal ulcer by edges and satellites
Herpetic versus bacterial by dendrites and sensation
Perforation versus descemetocele by Seidel and chamber depth
additionalInvestigations: Corneal scraping with Gram, KOH and culture
Confocal microscopy for atypical or cystic disease
